summary: Describes how to use TLS to secure NETCONF, the protocol for installing, changing and deleting the configuration of network devices. It was replaced by RFC 7589.

eli5.summary: Managing network equipment remotely needs a private tunnel. This note says how to use the web-style lock, TLS, to keep those management messages safe. It was later replaced by RFC 7589.

questions: how to run netconf over tls
